title: On the Trail of Count Dooku
front_description: Obi-Wan, Anakin and Padmé give chase to the escaping Count Dooku. But before they get very far, their gunship banks and Padmé tumbles out. "I can't leave her!" the younger Jedi shouts, horrified. But Obi-Wan manages to steady his passion-struck protege. "What do you think Padmé would do if she were in your position?" he tells him. "She would do her duty," Anakin agrees after a moment, resigned to the situation.
back_description: Natalie Portman, Ewan McGregor and Hayden Christensen on the rocking gunship set.
